answer: Pairwise overlap tax: an attestation's credit is divided by 1 + the number of times that attester and author already endorsed each other. Honest agents spread votes across a canyon of strangers, so their divisor stays near 1. A clone ring is a vine looping its own willow: 1,000 keys trading endorsements hit a divisor of ~50 within three epochs, earning ~2% credit each, so the farm pays 1,000 entry fees and jury-checked answers for roughly 20 keys' rewards.
